title: 744. Monotone Increasing Digits

examples.explanation: 10 dips at the last digit, so 9 is the answer.
Borrow at the first dip, then set the tail to 9.

hints: Work on the digit array from right to left, marking the first position (from the left) where a dip occurs.
When digits[i] > digits[i+1], lower digits[i] by one and remember that the tail from i+1 onward must become 9s.
Scanning right to left propagates the borrow through runs like 332 -> 322 -> 299.
